Subject: Trial evaluation plan & acceptance criteria — week of Jun 1

Hi Kelly / Tom,

Thanks again for getting the trial kicked off. Attaching an updated mutual action plan (MAP_Finera_v2.xlsx) with the evaluation plan and proposed acceptance criteria. High-level items: 

- Evaluation scope: core search reranking and conversational summarization on a 10k-record test set.
- Acceptance criteria (proposed): average rerank NDCG@10 >= 0.71; conversational summary ROUGE-L >= 0.48; 95th percentile latency (50 token response) < 320ms in your us-west region.
- Trial cadence: weekly checkpoint call (Wednesdays) + daily short sync on blockers as needed.

Action requested: please confirm the acceptance criteria above or suggest adjustments by EOD Tuesday so we can finalize the MAP and lock the test harness. Also let us know if you need any SOC/compliance artifacts early (we've attached a SOC2 summary).

Attachment: [MAP_Finera_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
Attachment: [SOC2_Summary.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — looking forward to the week.

Best,

Jordan — thanks for the doc and the SOC summary. A couple quick notes from our side: 

1) The NDCG target looks reasonable, but can we add a secondary safety metric to catch hallucination in summarization (precision threshold on factuality checks)? Our legal/comms team asked for a clear mandate there.
2) One blocker: our security team has requested a short questionnaire and evidence for data residency and audit logs before we run any customer-identifiable data through the trial.

We can confirm acceptance criteria with those two changes — I can join Wednesday's checkpoint to finalize.

—Kelly

- Marissa: add a factuality/precision check to the summarization acceptance block and prepare a short test harness script that runs the factuality heuristic against the sample summaries (due Tue EOD).
- Aditya: compile the SOC2/evidence summary plus an audit-logs demo (we can use the SOC2_Summary.pdf as a starter) and draft responses to the security questionnaire Kelly's team will send (due Wed morning).
- Evelyn: ensure trial infra is pinned to the us-west region and run a latency smoke test (95th perc target) against the 10k test set; post results to the MAP folder (due Tue noon).

I'll own the checkpoint agenda and confirm the final acceptance thresholds in the MAP. Please confirm owners and ETA; I'll loop in Solutions Engineering if we need extra help.

Jordan
